decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is a further development of the established BASIC 518 trommel screen, so it builds directly on the firm's core screening knowledge and is easy to keep improving.
The AK flail shredder line was updated to EU Stage V engines, which shows ongoing investment in a mobile shredding line close to the firm's core competence.

The mobile high-speed grinder line gained a page of its own in 2019 and fits the firm's mobile shredding expertise, but the earlier withdrawal of the green-waste grinder variant suggests this segment may be consolidated.

The CERON single-shaft pre-shredder generation is presented as setting benchmarks and was already used in customer plants, so it builds on the firm's stationary shredding knowledge and offers feedback it can learn from.
